items.title: Glover Compton Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: No, Ellington wasn't there the whole time I was there.

ctx.x: Ellington, I guess, he was over there too, wasn't he?
No, Ellington wasn't there the whole time I was there. No. But I used to come back, when I come back, and...
Did you see Armstrong over there? Yes, he sent for me.
